decisions.reason: As a close-to-core formwork profile line with several models, it still fits the firm's modular systems business and is worth retaining unless later sales clearly disappoint.
This automation add-on supports the firm's strategic push toward more automated factory solutions, so management would keep it unless its market uptake has remained persistently weak.
Magnetic formwork strips are tightly aligned with the existing offer and likely inexpensive to continue, which makes continued commercialization the more attractive option.
Although several years have now passed since launch, this magnetic formwork component remains near the core portfolio and can still be kept as a useful complementary module.
Because this item had lower prominence from the start and appears to overlap with related magnetic components, the option value now looks limited and resources are better redirected.
